target.statement: DEI2N achieves AUC 0.7671 on the Alibaba.com dataset, outperforming all baselines.

compute.basis: Training one epoch on 5.2M samples took 576 minutes on a 41-core CPU with 330 GB RAM and a V100 GPU; the Alibaba.com dataset is proprietary and not publicly available.

blockers: Alibaba.com dataset is proprietary and not released
Training requires large memory (330 GB) and a GPU (V100)
Even with data, one epoch takes ~10 hours on the paper's hardware
title: Deep Evolutional Instant Interest Network for CTR Prediction in Trigger-Induced Recommendation
